app.name: Dot VPN
route.blocked: Traffic stays blocked until a route works.
home.proxyOnly: Proxy only. Traffic is not routed.
first.title: Set up Dot VPN
first.body: Dot VPN needs a one-time setup to change your network settings. You approve it once.
first.updateBody: This app includes a newer setup. Approve once to replace the installed one.
first.inviteBody: Ask the operator of your server for an invite link.
servers.title: Servers
servers.empty: No servers yet. Add an invite.
invite.title: Add an invite
invite.label: Invite link
invite.hint: Replaces the servers you have now.
account.title: Account
account.name: Name
account.unavailable: Account details unavailable. Reconnect or re-import your invite.
account.logoutHint: Removes this invite from the device. Prefs and bypass stay.
relay.title: Relay
relay.body: Curated relays are listed for you. Paste a community link or id to opt in.
routing.title: Bypass
routing.body: These go straight to the internet, not through Dot VPN.
routing.invalid: That is not a domain or an IP range.
routing.partial: Some entries were skipped; fix them and add again.
settings.title: Settings
settings.fullTunnelHint: Off serves a local proxy only.
settings.killSwitch: Block traffic if the tunnel drops
settings.dnsHint: Used by Dot VPN itself, as address:port.
settings.systemDnsHint: The resolver your device is using right now.
settings.dohHint: For bypass and ECH lookups only.
settings.unblockHint: Use if the internet stays blocked after a crash.
settings.reportHint: Uploads a scrubbed report, or opens GitHub if offline.
settings.reportBrowser: Opened a GitHub issue draft in your browser.
settings.crashReportingHint: Optional. Off by default. Never includes your traffic.
settings.applyNext: Connection settings apply at the next connect.
settings.noTray: No tray was found on this desktop. Closing the window quits the app.
about.title: About
about.limits: Dot VPN hides that you use a VPN. It does not hide that you use the internet.
err.bad_invite: This invite link isn't valid. Ask the operator for a new one.
err.busy: Dot VPN is busy. Disconnect first, then try again.
err.helper_down: Dot VPN isn’t set up yet. Finish setup to connect.
err.elevation: The change was not approved, so nothing was changed.
err.no_cli: Setup files are missing from this install. Reinstall Dot VPN.
err.version: Dot VPN needs an updated setup. Choose Update setup, then try again.
err.internal: Something went wrong. Nothing was changed.
err.fallback: Couldn't reach the server. Trying the next route.
err.failed: Couldn't connect. Dot VPN keeps trying.
